x: Jock Mackenzie in the Discus should again show improvement and will be backed up by Sid Jones and Bill Sutton. Sid and Bill will be our Shot Putters, but Jock Mackenzie and Les Christmas have possibilities if they only get down to training.

In the field events, Bergvalds won the Discus; Bill Sutton was second in the Shot, and George Powell second in the Javelin Throw. The final scores were: L.A.C. and Dorking, 56 points each; Belgrave, 48.
Bill Sutton, Jock Mackenzie and Ans Bergvalds will be available for the Shot and Discus backed up by Doug. Childs, Terry Bateman, Len Higgins, Doug.
Bill Sutton gained third place in the Weight and we did not have any long-jumpers present. The final score in the Senior match was Mitcham A.C. 37; Herne Hill H. 35; Belgrave H. 15.

Bergvalds, our Latvian member, won the Discus and was second in the Shot Putt, with Bill Sutton in third place. Total points in the senior match were:—Cambridge H. 37½; Belgrave H. 34½; Blackheath H. 31.
Ches Walker won the 440 yards, with Odde in second place, and Jack Brown won the 880, with Archie Bedford fourth. Bill Sutton, D.
Allen won the Weight, with Bill Sutton second and Maclean and Holtum " obliged " in the High Jump in order to score points for third and fourth places.
We hope Bergvalds will get better support and look to Arthur Allen and Dennis Childs for this, as we cannot expect Bill Sutton to go on for ever.
John Bromley won the 2 miles run with Archie Bedford in 2nd place, and in the field events we had Luxon, Childs and Bill Sutton picking up a few points here and there.
Luxon in a similar position in the Long Jump event. Bill Sutton was third in the Weight and the final match points were—Herne Hill H., 60; Belgrave H., 38; Cambridge H., 23.
